title: Punctual tensor source and target functors
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $p:X^{\prime}\to X$, $f^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to S^{\prime}$, $g:T\to S^{\prime}$, $h:Y\to X^{\prime}$, $e:Y\to T$ be scheme maps. Use the degree-zero embedding and recorded derived tensor and inverse/direct images of [def-kun-prime-coefficient-constructions]. For an $A$-sheaf $E$ on $X$, define functors on $A$-sheaves $F$ on $T$ by $S_E(F)=p^{-1}E\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(f^{\prime})^{-1}Rg_*F$ and $T_E(F)=Rh_*(h^{-1}p^{-1}E\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}e^{-1}F)$. On a map $E\to E^{\prime}$ use the tensor bifunctor applied to its inverse image, and apply $Rh_*$ for the target. These are natural transformations of the displayed functors.
